The '''Drualkiin system''' was located in the [[Kessel sector/Legends|Kessel sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]<ref name="TEA" /> portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was situated on the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] known as the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]], which connected it to the [[Formos system/Legends|Formos system]] as well as the<ref name="TEA" /> [[Calaron sector/Legends|Calaron sector's]]<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Ku'Bakai system/Legends|Ku'Bakai system]]. The Drualkiin [[Star system/Legends|system]] served as a notable transshipment point for [[Spice/Legends|spice]],<ref name="TEA" /> and during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the spice-[[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Ill Wind (smuggler ship)|''Ill Wind'']] made runs through the Drualkiin and [[Kessel system/Legends|Kessel systems]].<ref name="TTaBS">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Drualkiin system was first mentioned in ''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]'', a [[1996]] sourcebook published for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TTaBS" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the system in grid square T-10.<ref name="TEA" />
